How it was tested

MANTA pressed Tab to the skip link, pressed Enter on it, then pressed Tab once more.

It flags the link when its target is missing or not shown, or when focus did not go to the target and the next Tab landed before it.

Flagged for review: check skip-link-moves-focus — Skip link to "#main-content": after Enter, no element has the id or name "main-content".

Run through MANTA’s interaction harness: on a fresh copy of the page of its own, apart from the one axe-core read, with real key presses and pointer moves. Requests that send data and loads of another page were blocked. Before the rule ran, MANTA recorded the focus order by pressing Tab through the page and then Shift+Tab back, and the rule read that record. The rule was given up to 30 seconds.
